title: Properly escape HTML entities in sampleDelim to avoid XSS issue
issueTitle: Bug report: XSS vulnerability due to unescaped value in OffsetChecker.mjs
why: The report says the Offset checker's sample delimiter goes into the output without escaping, so a delimiter containing HTML tags should show up as literal text in the fixed build, while the buggy build renders it as markup and the tags disappear.
